message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the appropriate charge(s) based on the facts.

Facts: In 2017, a construction company needed to bid. The prosecutor says: Zhang (defendant) obtained a legitimate query result letter from the procuratorate showing a staff (Tu) had a bribery record. The company needed to meet a requirement that only records within three years are considered. Since Tu's record is older than three years? Actually the letter shows a record from 2012 (maybe within 5 years). The company wants to hide it. Zhang printed a fake letter, deleting the record, changing the query period from 2007-2017 to 2013-2017, and forged the official seal by copying it from the original letter. He gave the fake letter to the company, which used it to get a site survey certificate.

Thus the crime is forging a document of a state organ (procuratorate) and its official seal. This is "伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章". The list includes that exact label.

Also possibly "伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章". Yes.

Any other charges? Possibly "行贿" but not here. The act is forging a document to hide a bribery record. So the charge is forging state documents.

Thus answer: [罪名]伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章<eoa>

Check if any other relevant: maybe "妨害公务"? No. The act is forging a document, not interfering with official duties. So single charge.
